build_attention_module: build a PyTorch Attention module with query, value, and hidden size parameters for sequence attention
build_key_value_attention: build a KeyValueAttention module that computes attention over separate key and value tensors
build_masked_attention: build a MaskedAttention module that applies length-based masking to attention logits
build_birnn_attention: build a BiRnnAttention module with forward and backward GRUs for chunked sequence attention
build_hierarchical_attention: build a HierarchicalAttention module with word-level and sentence-level attention over chunked sequences
